notes: This is the synthesis-test region — the combined tighter-feather + tighter-dilate variant (alpha_feather=4, mask_dilate=4 over BTN-stable H). halo_presence is a clean 5: no bright luminance halo around the Red Bull wordmark; the canonical Melbourne floor halo is fully absent. Compared to P3-A6/a2 (feather=2, dilate=8) the edge_seam_visibility dimension recovers to 4: the perimeter is no longer a hard step — feather=4 carries enough falloff to soften the patch edge against the surrounding paint, and the matched dilate=4 means the tight feather is no longer fighting an over-trimmed mask. A very faint perimeter line is still visible on the top edge in mid/late strips on slow scrub but does not pop. Compared to P3-A5 baseline (feather=8, dilate=8): seam dimension is one step weaker (4 vs 5) — feather=8 is still the seam-cleanest option — but halo and edge_reflex are equal-or-cleaner. Player contact shadow remains the weak axis (mark stays opaque under feet); BTN's stable H prevents jitter. Verdict on the experiment: feather=4 + dilate=4 is the best halo/seam balance of the P3-A6 sweep — better than a2's hard step, on-par with A5 minus a half-step on seam.
